items.title: Howard Mandel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: oh, who’s the pianist out of Chicago, the traditional pianist — Art Hodes.

ctx.x: And I think that his perspective on what he does — I do not think that musicians share the perspective that jazz critics share on the music. Musicians are focused on what they’re doing and they understand what they’re doing internally. They’re not necessarily able to articulate it, and we’re not looking to them to do that. I think a good jazz journalist who is doing interviews helps the musician to articulate what they’re doing for the reader. But we can help them because we’re supposed to be good with words the…
